No one appears to have exercised this path on real hardware. However, the change is purely informational — it changes labels in a status display, not behavior, memory usage, or model loading decisions. It is not part of the critical release surface that would warrant a blocker or Needs Attention verdict.

The PR contained exactly two commits authored by @fl0rianr: the initial 'fix(app): model report shared GPU memory correctly' (sha 0f2bdb8, 2026-10-22) and the follow-up 'fix(app): ignore unavailable physical memory' (sha 6b5a5, 2026-10-27T01:10:50). evidence.review: PR #3944 was approved by @meghsat at 2026-10-27T01:19:18Z. @fl0rianr (the author) is a maintainer with subject area expertise in GUI/app (per docs/dev/contribute.md), but did not self-approve — @meghsat provided the sole human approval. subject: fix(app): model report shared GPU memory correctly (#3944)
summary: Fixes the Lemonade app model info display to report AMD integrated GPU memory as 'Unified memory (shared with system RAM)' with separate lines for reserved GPU memory and shared GTT capacity, and filters out the Windows sentinel string 'Physical memory information not found.' from system info output.
verdict_reason: A small, targeted display fix to AMD iGPU memory reporting with a single human approval, all automated checks passing, and no post-approval churn or security risk.
